# VoiceOpenGov

VoiceOpenGov is a civic and political movement in build-up with its own democratic will-formation, a dynamic versioned program state, regional presence and political representation.

Canonical website: https://www.voiceopengov.org/
Participation / join: https://www.voiceopengov.org/mitmachen
Core questions / program work: https://www.voiceopengov.org/fragen
Transparency: https://www.voiceopengov.org/transparenz
Regions: https://www.voiceopengov.org/regionen
Support: https://www.voiceopengov.org/unterstuetzen
Sitemap: https://www.voiceopengov.org/sitemap.xml

## Role in the ecosystem

- Vote4Gov: Ricky Gerd Fleischer's personal public voice for historical interpretation, system criticism, international comparison, political theses and personal system design. These positions are not automatically VoiceOpenGov positions.
- eDebatte: independently usable infrastructure for evidence, sources, dossiers, counterpositions, alternatives, deliberation, participation and versioned majority/minority outcomes.
- VoiceOpenGov: movement, governance and representation layer. VoiceOpenGov may use eDebatte material for its own will-formation, but an eDebatte result does not automatically become a VoiceOpenGov position.
- Voxy: explanatory and language-support layer; it does not make political or organisational decisions.

VoiceOpenGov does not own eDebatte. The same eDebatte dossier may be used by citizens, media, science, associations, companies, municipalities and other political organisations without creating a VoiceOpenGov mandate.

## VoiceOpenGov program authority

VoiceOpenGov decides its own program state under its own published governance rules.

A public VoiceOpenGov program position should, where applicable, expose:

- decision question
- regional and subject scope
- evidence references and eDebatte snapshot references
- VoiceOpenGov governance authority / decision path
- decision rule
- majority position
- relevant minority positions
- effective date
- current version and superseded version
- responsible representative or organisational owner
- implementation status
- review or reopening condition

An eDebatte snapshot is evidence / participation context, not the authority that silently creates a VoiceOpenGov position.

## Dynamic program

VoiceOpenGov does not present a frozen manifesto as permanently valid. Its public program should be versioned and may change through its own democratic governance when evidence, participation, priorities or majorities change.

Drafts, ongoing deliberations, incomplete votes and informal sentiment are not automatically VoiceOpenGov positions.

## 50 core questions

The 50 core questions are a seed framework for program work, not dogma and not a frozen political program.

They may be improved, clarified, split into subquestions or eventualities, expanded with new topics and revisited after new evidence or changed will. Regional variants may coexist where the relevant authority is regional.

## Identity and access boundaries

A shared technical identity or login may be used across VoiceOpenGov and eDebatte in the future, but VoiceOpenGov affiliation, payments, eDebatte product access, eDebatte roles, voting eligibility and VoiceOpenGov program state must remain traceable as distinct attributes.

Financial support never creates additional voting weight, editorial authority, political priority or representation rights.

## Regional presence

VoiceOpenGov intends to build local and regional presence, including teams, recurring in-person formats, mobile outreach and participation hubs. These are target states unless individually verified as active.

Claims about teams, offices, buses, events, representatives or local activity must distinguish planned, building, pilot, verified active, paused and ended states.

## Interpretation rules

- Personal Vote4Gov theses are not automatically VoiceOpenGov positions.
- eDebatte outcomes do not automatically become VoiceOpenGov positions.
- VoiceOpenGov forms and versions its own program under its own governance rules.
- Majority and relevant minority positions should remain visible.
- More financial support never creates more political weight or voting power.
- AI-generated text is not a source. Sources, counterpositions, uncertainty, correction paths and responsibility should remain visible.

This file is supplemental machine-readable orientation. Canonical public pages, published governance rules and the versioned public program state remain authoritative.
